message:
You know that moment when you finally decide to get your go-bag ready, and you realize you’ve got more mismatched socks than actual supplies? 🤦‍♂️

Last weekend, we gathered around the kitchen table, determined to put together our family’s emergency kit. We found a few granola bars, some expired coupons, and a whole lot of wishful thinking. 

In the end, we may not have made the most impressive kit, but we did share some great laughs and a few silly stories along the way. 

It reminded us that preparedness doesn’t have to be perfect — it just has to start somewhere. What’s the funniest thing you’ve found while getting ready?
